name: Ech xao sa ot
summary: Ếch xào sả ớt is frog stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, one of the seafood-pub plates on Phan Tứ, with grilled stingray and a seafood hotpot.
howToEat: Order it on Phan Tứ in the evening.
where: Phan Tứ, Ngũ Hành Sơn. The 2019 account prints 17:00–24:00.
seoTitle: Ech xao sa ot — lemongrass chili frog on Phan Tu
